deviations.description: Redeploy via deploy-headless.sh and diff -q parity confirmation against .claude/scripts/
deviations.reason: Explicit live-machinery-hazard instruction from the delegating orchestrator: a concurrent /orchestrate multi-task loop is running RIGHT NOW in this repo and calls .claude/scripts/state-write.sh and .claude/scripts/task-lock.sh between every dispatch. Running deploy-headless.sh would overwrite the live .claude/scripts/ tree out from under that concurrent loop -- explicitly forbidden ('Do NOT run deploy-headless.sh or otherwise overwrite the live .claude/scripts/ copies yourself -- the orchestrator owns redeployment at its own inter-cycle checkpoint'). Per the same instruction, verification was performed against a scratch copy of the fixed source-store scripts instead (Acceptance 1-4 below all ran against that scratch copy, using the real live specs/ROADMAP.md and specs/state.json as inputs). The source-store commit (agent-system repo, commit 67876e6b3) is in place and ready; the actual deploy + diff -q parity check must happen at the orchestrator's own next redeploy checkpoint.

deviations.description: git-snapshot.sh default-mode revert accidentally stashed concurrent orchestrator state changes
deviations.reason: Ran `bash .claude/scripts/git-snapshot.sh 487` (default mode) as literally specified by the plan's Phase 7 task list, without first checking that default mode REVERTS the working tree (git stash push -u). This stashed away specs/state.json, specs/TODO.md, and specs/events.jsonl changes that belonged to OTHER concurrently-running orchestrator/task activity (not this task's own work), which could have disrupted those other sessions. Caught immediately via the script's own printed warning and `git stash show -p`, and corrected by `git stash pop` right away (stash@{0}, dropped cleanly) before any other write occurred, then re-ran with `--no-revert` (the correct mode for a live-machinery context) to take the actual durable backup. No concurrent session's data was lost; the window was seconds and no other write happened during it.
